blurb: John A. White Golf Course is a public-access 9-hole golf course located in Southwest Atlanta. Our regulation par-35 course is quick, fun, fair, and challenging to play. Originally opened in 1929, the course was completely renovated in 1999 by Billy Fuller and Bob Cupp and most recently, the bunkers and greens were renovated in 2022.
